name: chat-review-typed
title: Chat Review Typed
description: A headline with the shop name on its own line, a customer's avatar and name, an incoming bubble with typing dots that then writes the review letter by letter, a dark reply bubble sliding in from the right, five stars with a score line, and a call-to-action pill. White page, hairline bubbles.
useWhen: A customer review, a viewer comment or a student message should be shown as proof.
A short message (up to about 110 characters) that is worth reading as it is typed.
avoidWhen: A long text or several reviews: use one block per review, or a testimonial card layout.
You need the look of a specific messaging app: this is a generic bubble chat.
author: Mosio

variables.label: Headline lead
variables.description: Plain words before the subject name.

variables.label: Subject
variables.description: Shop or product name, on its own line under the lead.

variables.label: Customer name
variables.description: Name above the review. Its first letter fills the avatar.

variables.label: Review
variables.description: The message typed letter by letter. About 60 to 110 characters reads best.
variables.default: Kue lapisnya lembut banget, anak-anak sampai rebutan. Minggu depan pesan lagi ya!

variables.label: Reply
variables.description: The shop's reply bubble. Leave empty to skip it.
variables.default: Terima kasih, Bu Sari! Ditunggu pesanannya

variables.label: Score line
variables.description: Line under the stars. Leave empty to hide the stars and the line.

variables.label: Main colour
variables.description: Call to action: the one accent.
